Foreign Affairs
Cr. & Sp. Branch

423
Date 31 - 1 - 44 November 25, 1943.

Further to report re dispute over owner-
ship of a piano.

Reference to the attached report re disputed
ownership of piano 'Mutry', valued $30.000.00, enqui-
ries were made by the undersigned and the following was
ascertained.

The piano is, at the present time, in possession
of Mrs.M.Dostal, Czechoslovakian, residing at 23 Rue
Corniolle, to whom it was given for safe keeping, at
the beginning of this year, by Mr.V.Radzivill, Russian
Emigrant, now deceased, whilst he was living at 141-131
Wuchang Rd.

Prior to his death Mr.V.Radzivill was living
for about one month with his friend A.G.Zenchonkoff,
732 Embankment Building, and on 21.9.43. made a "Will
and Statement", through attorney at law A.A.Melikoff,
88 Paul Henry, according to which all his property,
including piano "Mutry" in temporary use of Mrs.Dostal,
was bequeathed to Mr.A.G.Zenchenkoff.

Following Mr.V.Radzivill's death, on 22.9.43.,
Mr.A.G.Zenchenkoff produced the "Will and Testament"
at the Procurator's Office of the Shanghai District
Court, where it was probated on 25.10.43.

Mrs.M.Dostal was summoned to the Arbitration
Court on 30.10.43. but failed to appear, and her repre-
sentative stated that the piano in question was given
by
to her ^ Mr.Radzivill as a present. He failed, however,
to produce any proofs.

Having sought advice from the Police, and being
referred to civil court, Mr.Zench nkoff entered an
action against Mrs.Dostal at the Civil Court, and the
case is pending now.

外事处
刑事与特别分支

423
日期 31 - 1 - 44 1943年11月25日。

续报关于一架钢琴所有权争议之事。

兹就所附关于价值30,000.00美元的“Mutry”牌钢琴所有权争议的报告，经下文签署人查询，查明情况如下。

该钢琴目前由居住在科尼奥尔路（Rue Corniolle）23号的捷克斯洛伐克籍M.多斯塔尔夫人（Mrs. M. Dostal）占有。今年年初，当时居住在武昌路141-131号的俄罗斯流亡者V.拉季维利先生（Mr. V. Radzivill，现已去世）将该钢琴交给她保管。

在去世前约一个月，V.拉季维利先生与其朋友A.G.琴申科夫先生（Mr. A. G. Zenchonkoff，住外滩大楼732号）同住，并于1943年9月21日通过律师A.A.梅利科夫（A. A. Melikoff，住保罗·亨利路88号）订立了一份“遗嘱及声明”，据此，他的所有财产，包括暂由多斯塔尔夫人使用的“Mutry”牌钢琴，均遗赠给A.G.琴申科夫先生。

V.拉季维利先生于1943年9月22日去世后，A.G.琴申科夫先生向上海地方法院检察官办公室提交了该“遗嘱及 testament”，该遗嘱已于1943年10月25日获得认证。

多斯塔尔夫人于1943年10月30日被传唤至仲裁法庭，但未出庭，其代表称涉案钢琴系^拉季维利先生赠送给她的礼物。然而，他未能提供任何证据。

在征询警方意见并被告知应诉诸民事法庭后，琴申科夫先生向民事法庭对多斯塔尔夫人提起诉讼，目前该案尚在审理中。

pages.en:
Foreign Affairs
Cr. & Sp. Branch
November 25, 1943.

██████████ - 2 -

When Mrs. Dostal was visited by the undersigned
on the matter, her representative, Mr. C. Basnan, Soviet
citizen, in very insolent manner refused to give any
particulars regarding the case, stating that Police
has nothing to do with it as the case is being dealt
with by the Civil Court. He stated, however, that he
was going to dispute the ownership over the piano at
the Civil Court, because he had some proofs that the
piano was given to Mrs. Dostal by the deceased (Mr. Rad-
zivill) as a present.

....................
D.S.I.

Officer in charge
Foreign Affairs Branch.
pages.zh:
外事处
刑事与特别分支
1943年11月25日。

██████████ - 2 -

当下文签署人就此事拜访多斯塔尔夫人时，其代表、苏联公民C.巴斯南先生（Mr. C. Basnan）以非常无礼的态度拒绝提供有关该案的任何细节，声称警方与此事无关，因为该案正由民事法庭处理。然而，他表示将在民事法庭对钢琴的所有权提出争议，因为他有一些证据证明该钢琴是死者（拉季维利先生）作为礼物送给多斯塔尔夫人的。

....................
D.S.I.

主管官员
外事处
